limitations: Initial baseline and replay readback failures remain failed; recovered success does not erase them.
The two native profiles are not an isolated allocator performance benchmark.
All roles share one Docker VM; no physical power-loss or independent-host durability proof.
Full snapshot equality does not prove end-to-end exactly-once.
The source recipe uses deterministic modulo formulas; the printed seed field is unused for source generation.
